structure: Part 14 mined two whole-journey traces from journeys.fit.spec.js › notification journeys end to end, and read that spec in full. (1) 'pet cats by air: microchip identification and permanent address' (zip journeys--...-pet-cats-by-air-..., 255 actions, 0 errors, reference GBN-AG-26-04XE9O). Run order: create-notification (live-animals) > origin-of-the-import (Spain, no region code) > what-are-you-importing (Domestic cat) > reason-for-import (Internal market, Companion animal not for resale or rehoming) > consignment-details (2 animals) > animal-identification-details (2 cats, microchip, passport, tattoo, each saved with the per-species save button) > additional-animal-details (Other) > arrival-details (Air, Heathrow) > transporter (Aberdeen Livestock) > upload-documents (one ITAHC added) > roles-and-addresses (place of origin, consignor, consignee, importer, place of destination, then permanent address: cat 1 same as POD, cat 2 a new address) > notification-hub > review-notification > declaration (refused once, then confirmed) > notification-submitted > review-notification?reference=. It skips total gross weight and transit countries. (2) 'germinal products: bovine semen with quantity, packages, gross weight and donor identification' (zip journeys--...-germinal-products-bovine-semen-..., 252 actions, 0 errors, reference GBN-AG-26-0HEZYX). Run order: create-notification?category=germinal-products straight to origin-of-the-import (Netherlands) > what-are-you-importing (Cattle semen) > reason-for-import (Internal market, Breeding) > consignment-details (quantity 20, packages 4, Frozen) > consignment-gross-weight (12.5) > animal-identification-details (donor, collection date, production date, identification number) > arrival-details (Road, Dover) > transit-countries (Belgium) > transporter (Portuguese Livestock) > upload-documents > roles-and-addresses (five core addresses, no permanent address) > hub > review > declaration > submitted > the submitted record. It skips the notification type page, additional details and permanent address. Pages snapshotted from these traces: cat roles-and-addresses (action 142), permanent address (136), hub (165), review (183), declaration (201) and its error (210), submitted (231), submitted record (238, 241); germinal origin (10), roles-and-addresses (133), hub (158), review (180), declaration error (207), submitted (228), submitted record (238). POST requests of the germinal trace read for integrations. Page-by-page detail of the steps before the hub belongs to parts 1 to 12; claimed here only where these traces show something journey-specific.

I confirm I am responsible for this consignment.

cleared official checks at the border
reached the Place of Destination as stated on the health certificate or notification
I confirm that I am accountable for:
any payment for the official controls at the border
any arrangements to re-dispatch the consignment
any costs needed for quarantine or isolation of consignments
any costs needed for destruction and disposal of consignments, when instructed by the authorities

I am authorised as being accountable for these things if raising notifications on behalf of a third party.

I can legally act on behalf of a third party in relation to the conditions of this declaration.
